description: Most of the major telecom service providers in India allow subscribers to check 5G network coverage in their area. Airtel, Vi, and Jio have dedicated network coverage portals, which provide colour-coded coverage interactive maps. If you know which service provider offers a 5G network in your area, you can simply choose the plan of that particular company. On top of this, if none of the TSPs offer 5G coverage in your area, you can choose to buy devices with only 4G LTE connectivity, which are usually cheaper than the 5G-enabled devices.
title: How to Check 5G Coverage in Your City Online For Vi, Jio and Airtel
